about: Pin record for the adopted bestiary source of NAT.07.01 (lane-ex). The source file beside this record is a verbatim copy and is never edited. A change to the bestiary is a new source file with a new pin and a new build, never an edit of this one.
origin: braintrust 2026-09-30, Grok Heavy voice; no BESTIARY-MERGE was run
lineEndings: LF; the hash is taken over the file with CRLF folded to LF, so a CRLF checkout hashes the same
inputs: Only the 317 srd:creature: rows (source lines 3-319) are build inputs. Sections A (occupancy grid), B (wildlife map) and C (recommendations) are not inputs; see docs/systems/DEUS_Bestiary.md.
verbatimNotes: The source spells the world 'Emrys' at lines 21, 125, 186, 187 and 361. The copy keeps that spelling because it is a source record; the generated game/data/srd_adaptation/creatures.json writes 'Emerys' (DEC-054).
